title: Aedequte chairs
text: Aedequte chairs. I was kind of desperate for chairs when I got these. They're alright. They look nice, but they aren't that comfortable, and I imagine if you plan on having a larger person sit in them, they might be even more uncomfortable. They were easy to assemble and they look decent enough.
